hooks.text: 动态生成节拍同时约束攻击与闪避，敌我都随音乐行动
hooks.excerpt: Players must follow dynamically generated beats, striking enemies with precision while dodging attacks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 精准踩拍为武器蓄能，持续连击会触发加速狂热模式
hooks.excerpt: Hitting the beat accurately quickly builds weapon energy, allowing for powerful skill releases. Maintaining a combo will trigger Frenzy Mode, significantly increasing attack speed and rhythm tempo, creating a seamless, exhilarating combat experience.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 为永葆青春闯入不死塔，在无尽怪潮中争夺不朽宝藏
hooks.excerpt: On her quest for beauty, she hears tell of the Deathless Tower, which spawns an endless stream of monsters, and—so the rumor goes—holds a treasure that grants immortality. If she gets her hands on that treasure, she can stay young and beautiful forever!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
